semiconductor_relevance: High — Oxford Instruments provides advanced equipment and solutions critical for semiconductor fabrication and characterization processes.
summary: Oxford Instruments is a leading provider of high technology products and services that enhance semiconductor fabrication and characterization. Their offerings include advanced imaging and analysis tools, as well as etch and deposition equipment essential for both R&D and manufacturing applications in the semiconductor industry.
capabilities: Raman imaging microscopy for 3D visualization of component distribution
Atomic Force Microscopy (AFM) for defect and property characterization
Electron microscopy techniques including EDS and EBSD
Plasma technology solutions for precise etch and deposition processes
